about.title: More than code.
about.content:
I'm a software developer with experience across
Full Stack Development, QA Automation,
Business Intelligence and Mobile Applications.

Throughout my career I've worked in banking,
healthcare, government institutions and
commercial platforms, helping teams build
reliable software and improve processes through
automation.

Today I'm focused on creating useful products,
learning continuously and leveraging AI-assisted
development to build faster and smarter.
